entities.name: André Philip
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Philip was a French politician of the SFIO who served in 1942 as Interior Minister under the Free French provisional government of General Charles de Gaulle. He also served as a finance minister in 1946 and part of 1947 in the Socialist-led governments of Felix Gouin, Leon Blum and Paul Ramadier.
